requirement: AFO MUST audit current 001–004 source/evidence/installed tools and record IMPLEMENTED/PARTIAL/MISSING without inventing a capability.
AFO MUST fail closed under a versioned schema-validated policy; current constitutional, 002/003/004 and OS restrictions take precedence.
AFO MUST start DISABLED or OBSERVE_ONLY; enabling PILOT/ACTIVE requires external authorization bound to scope, expiry and policy hash.
AFO MUST NOT modify existing CRE configuration or enable CRE ACTIVE implicitly; authorization intersection decides every action.
AFO MUST preserve pinned versions, the approved ASPICE process baseline, safety evidence and all 001–004 regression gates.
AFO MUST maintain a non-LLM deterministic decision record for every admission, retry, plan approval, stop and operator control.
AFO MUST use separate service/account permissions and explicit MCP/SKILL contracts for any newly introduced AI role.
AFO MUST never claim that an E2E BLOCKED archive is an accepted engineering package.
AFO MUST manage each runtime dependency through systemd, rather than relying on nohup; failures get bounded automatic restarts and probes.
AFO MUST have its own headless Conductor systemd service; the current supervisor continues independently, including Fabro-down monitoring.
AFO MUST verify a persistent mounted FORGE_DATA_ROOT before writing and refuse ephemeral fallback.
AFO MUST document and test operator-approved systemd lingering/boot-session behavior and stable mount dependencies.
AFO MUST propagate readiness/health states for Ollama, gateway, Fabro, dashboard, supervisor, data store and Conductor.
AFO MUST provide independent watchdog/heartbeat of the Conductor, detecting hang, repeated restart and missed polls.
AFO MUST prevent service restart storms and avoid starting workloads while mandatory dependencies are unhealthy or UNKNOWN.
AFO SHOULD run runtime processes with least privilege and scoped credentials, including separation of repair/verifier identities where supported.
AFO MUST accept only schema-validated explicitly approved work-order envelopes with immutable input manifests and provenance hashes.
AFO MUST deduplicate `(tenant_scope,request_id)` atomically and reject the same ID with a different manifest hash.
AFO MUST store work-order, attempt, event, lease and outbox state durably before external side effects.
AFO MUST expose queue admission and worker concurrency limits, starting with one worker by default.
AFO MUST require healthy storage, model, MCP capability and authorization preflight before admitting work.
AFO MUST retain stable order identity across all retries; attempts SHALL have unique monotonically ordered identities.
AFO MUST implement lease fencing and atomic compare-and-swap admission so two Conductor instances cannot dispatch one work item.
AFO MUST schedule a finite approved backlog continuously when capacity is available and remain healthy without generating work when idle.
AFO SHOULD support priority classes and aging/fairness with proof of no starvation for permanently eligible work.
AFO SHOULD support pause, drain and resume as authenticated, audit-logged operations that do not mutate accepted work products.
AFO MUST use an append-only transaction outbox for each launch/recovery/finalize command with stable idempotency key and fencing token.
AFO MUST treat Fabro CLI launch as potentially ambiguous until an authoritative run receipt is reconciled.
AFO MUST correlate attempts to actual Fabro run labels/metadata and quarantine zero/duplicate/unknown matches as specified in the crash matrix.
AFO MUST reconcile in-progress, terminal, missing and unreachable Fabro runs across Conductor restart and machine reboot.
AFO MUST persist checkpoint hashes from independently accepted SWE phases and invalidate downstream evidence when an upstream dependency changes.
AFO MUST use verified work-order-level resume, not invent unproven Fabro-native checkpoint APIs.
AFO MUST guard side effects using existing CRE replay classes; uncertain non-replayable actions SHALL NOT execute a second time.
AFO MUST distinguish terminal Fabro state, valid sealed package, BLOCKED engineering outcome and READY quality outcome.
AFO MUST use unique immutable workspaces and release archives per attempt without overwriting previous evidence.
AFO SHOULD provide transactional backup/restore and replay-deterministic projections for queue and outbox state.
AFO MUST ingest structured, authoritative SWE gate/inspection/compile/test failures, not only service-level health or AI summaries.
AFO MUST classify PRODUCT_QUALITY, INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSIENT_DEPENDENCY, FACTORY_CODE_DEFECT, SPECIFICATION_GAP, SECURITY and UNKNOWN distinctly.
AFO MUST compute canonical cross-attempt failure signatures while preserving relevant phase/check/tool provenance and removing volatile identifiers.
AFO MUST try deterministic known remediation and validated CRE lessons before calling a diagnosis model.
AFO MUST provide a scoped, bounded SKILL-governed Recovery Planner agent that emits a schema-valid plan and never executes privileged operations.
AFO MUST validate strategy admissibility, scope, change-impact mapping and material difference independently of model output.
AFO MUST allow scoped product-draft repair or upstream phase rework only within the approved work order and preserve inspector independence.
AFO MUST prevent identical plan/fingerprint retry storms across stages, restarts and attempt IDs.
AFO MUST enforce cumulative token/turn/CPU-GPU/wall-clock/attempt/strategy budgets, including local Qwen runs.
AFO MUST block or escalate immediately on missing authoritative HSI, requested safety/acceptance modification or unknown non-replayable effects.
AFO MUST produce a new attempt with proper downstream reinspection when an admissible recovery plan changes a baseline.
AFO SHOULD switch among pre-authorized model profiles only when doing so is materially justified and never add a paid endpoint implicitly.
AFO MUST distinguish factory-source defects from product defects and never grant general source editing to infrastructure fabric-repair.
AFO SHOULD provide a dedicated Factory Maintainer SKILL/agent for proposing narrowly scoped non-protected patches in isolated worktrees.
AFO SHOULD require a reproducer that fails on baseline and passes on candidate before accepting a source-defect root cause.
AFO SHOULD run 004 independent promotion gate with frozen negative/golden/holdout tests, policy integrity and security before any proposal is eligible.
AFO MUST prohibit automatic persistent factory source, skill, prompt, workflow, test-oracle or safety-policy deployment, even if CRE reports ELIGIBLE.
AFO SHOULD produce a traceable staged branch/pull request with link to 004 CAPA, reproducible tests and a human-review decision.
AFO SHOULD quarantine rejected, unsafe or non-reproducible proposed changes and preserve all prior evidence.
AFO MUST keep unrelated approved work orders running on the last approved factory revision during a pending source change.
AFO SHOULD add a bounded WAITING_EXTERNAL_CHANGE TTL and finalize pending order BLOCKED when no approved change arrives.
AFO MUST create a single immutable BLOCKED package and deduplicated DLQ case on exhausted/out-of-scope attempts while processing unrelated work.
AFO MUST expose reason code, work-order and attempt IDs, phase, required human action, immutable artifact refs and uncertainty.
AFO MUST persist and deduplicate alerts with rate limit/backoff, without credentials, sensitive evidence or raw reasoning.
AFO SHOULD extend existing dashboard with queue, worker, errors, replan history, DLQ, service status and readiness using existing traces.
AFO SHOULD expose read-only versioned API for AFO status plus separately authenticated audited pause/drain/resume controls.
AFO MUST never let dashboard display filters delete events or disable mandatory security/audit capture.
AFO MUST attach AFO queue/recovery/exception evidence to the existing deterministic Release Manager archive.
AFO MUST calculate separate service availability, autonomous eligible-recovery rate, READY yield, attempts per order, human prompts/interventions and escaped failures.
AFO MUST preserve numerators/denominators, event provenance, cohort/version metadata and confidence intervals rather than report universal 100% reliability.
AFO MUST pass positive and negative crash/reboot/side-effect/fault-injection tests before enabling real PILOT.
AFO MUST perform reproducible real on-prem model work-order trials including at least one accepted READY and one deliberately BLOCKED outcome for an engineering-success claim.
AFO SHOULD demonstrate 24h smoke, 72h pilot and 168h unattended soak under recorded maintenance authorization and report actual outage exposure.
AFO MUST separate IMPLEMENTED, PILOT_ELIGIBLE, ACTIVE_ELIGIBLE and SLO_DEMONSTRATED readiness from configured mode; missing data means NOT_DEMONSTRATED.
AFO MUST maintain FR→task→test→evidence traceability; no unchecked P0 or failed regression may be described as complete.
AFO MUST record an explicit signed owner authorization before enabling any privileged ACTIVE operational action; agents cannot forge approvals.
